title: Fathom Is Free Forever. Otter Caps You At 300 Minutes
description:
Otter's free plan: 300 min/month, 30 min per meeting, 3 lifetime imports. Fathom's free plan: unlimited recordings and transcriptions. The catch: limited AI chat and no team features. #Shorts #ai #aitools
